events.title: 왓퍼드 sign 20-year-old striker Mo Johnston from 파틱 시슬 for £200,000.

리버풀 progress to the quarter-finals of the European Cup at the expense of Spanish champions Atletico Bilbao . 맨체스터 유나이티드 reach the quarter-finals of the European Cup Winners' Cup with a 4–1 aggregate win over Bulgarian side Spartak Varna . 토트넘 홋스퍼 eliminate Dutch side 페예노르트 6–2 on aggregate in the second round of the UEFA Cup. 왓퍼드 eliminate Levski Sofia from the competition and 노팅엄 포리스트 oust PSV 에인트호번 , but 애스턴 빌라 are edged out 4–3 on aggregate by Spartak Moscow .

울버햄프턴 원더러스 are bottom of the First Division and still winless after 12 games following a 5–0 defeat at 노팅엄 포리스트. Peter Withe scores twice as 애스턴 빌라 inflict a 2–1 defeat on 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford, meaning that 리버풀 can return to the top of the table if they win their game tomorrow. 아스널's erratic form continues as they lose 2–1 at home to 선덜랜드. There is no shortage of action in the race to reach the First Division. Second Division leaders 셰필드 웬즈데이 maintain a four-point lead at the top of the table by beating Yorkshire rivals 반즐리 2–0 at Hillsborough . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 win 3–2 at home to 풀럼. 맨체스터 시티 remain in the top three by beating 슈루즈버리 타운 3–1 at Gay Meadow . 첼시's promotion push takes a dent when they are held to a 1–1 draw by struggling Oldham at Boundary Park , but they are just three points outside the top three with a game in hand.
리버풀 go top of the First Division with a 3–0 win over 에버턴 in the Merseyside derby at Anfield .
에버턴 sign striker Andy Gray from 울버햄프턴 원더러스 for £250,000.

리버풀 remain top of the First Division despite being held to a 2–2 draw at 토트넘 홋스퍼. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 keep up the pressure with a 3–0 away win over 울버햄프턴 원더러스, who are still winless after 13 games. 맨체스터 유나이티드 miss the chance to return to the top of the table when they are held to a 1–1 draw at 레스터 시티. 사우샘프턴 climb from eighth to fourth with a 1–0 home win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. 아스널 suffer another setback when they lose 1–0 at 입스위치 타운. Brighton's hopes of an instant return to the First Division appear to be fading fast after a 4–0 defeat to 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road leaves them 16th in the Second Division. 첼시 close the gap between themselves and the top three with a 4–0 home win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
England fail to qualify for the European Championships despite a 4–0 away win over Luxembourg in their final qualifying game, as Denmark win 2–0 in Greece to top the group.

The first round of the FA Cup sees non-league sides Whitby Town and Telford United both overcome Football League opposition. In the First Division, 에버턴 manager Howard Kendall is under mounting pressure after a 2–1 defeat at 아스널 leaves his side 17th in the table. 토트넘 홋스퍼 continue their surge up the table with a 4–2 win over 루턴 타운 at Kenilworth Road . 리버풀 remain top with a 1–0 home win over 스토크 시티. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are still just a point behind the leaders with a 1–0 win over 선덜랜드 at Roker Park. Frank Stapleton scores a hat-trick in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 4–1 home win over 왓퍼드, which boosts their goal difference and keeps them level with 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and a single point behind 리버풀. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are still winless 14 games into the season and claim their fourth point with a goalless draw at home to fifth-placed 코번트리 시티. A 4–1 home win for 아스널 against 레스터 시티 takes some of the pressure off under-fire manager Terry Neill . In the Second Division, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 drop out of the top three with a 4–2 defeat at leaders 셰필드 웬즈데이, allowing 첼시 to climb into the promotion places despite being held to a 2–2 draw at home by their London rivals 크리스털 팰리스 . 맨체스터 시티 remain in the top three despite losing 2–0 to 칼라일 유나이티드 at Brunton Park .
Worcester City become the third non-league team this season to knock Football League opposition out of the FA Cup when they beat 올더숏 2–1.

FA Cup first round replays fail to produce any giant-killing feats but a non-league clash between London rivals Enfield and Wealdstone ends in a 2–2 draw and forces a second replay. There are also replays for four League Cup fourth round ties. Two of these matches go to a second replay – including 리버풀's clash with 풀럼 at Anfield, which ends in a 1–1 draw. The only league action of the day sees 첼시 go second in the table with a 3–1 win over 스완지 시티 at the Vetch Field . Swansea are now bottom of the Second Division with just one win from their first 15 games and are currently seven points adrift of safety, a mere 18 months after finishing sixth in the First Division.

왓퍼드 further boost their ranks with the £150,000 signing of 19-year-old defender David Bardsley from 블랙풀 . Maidstone United from the Alliance Premier League knock Third Division 엑서터 시티 out of the FA Cup in a first round replay.

케니 달글리시 scores his 100th competitive goal for 리버풀 in a 1-1 league draw against 입스위치 타운. Elsewhere, QPR fail to hold on to their lead at fellow Londoners Spurs, who win 3–2 thanks to Mark Falco 's double and Steve Archibald 's 15th of the season. 노츠 카운티 boost their bid to keep clear of the relegation zone with a 5–2 win over 애스턴 빌라. 레스터 시티 are just two points adrift of safety after a 3–0 home win over 아스널. 왓퍼드, runners-up in the league last season, are still in the bottom three after a 2–1 home defeat to local rivals 루턴 타운, who shoot up from 10th to fifth in the table. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 finally win a league game at the 15th attempt when they overcome local rivals 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 3–1 at The Hawthorns . The highest-scoring game of the day sees 번리 boost their hopes of a quick return to the Second Division when they beat bottom-of-the-table 포트 베일 7–0 at Turf Moor .

리버풀 remain top of the First Division after their nearest rivals 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 1–1 at Upton Park. A decisive result for either side would have seen the winner of the game going top of the league.

리버풀 finally beat 풀럼 at the third attempt by triumphing 1–0 in front of nearly 21,000 fans at Craven Cottage in their League Cup third round second replay. The fourth round tie between 아스널 and 월솔 at Highbury produces a shock result when the Third Division visitors win 2–1. The surprise result has echoes of 월솔's shock win over 아스널 back in January 1933, when they beat the Gunners 2–0 at Fellows Park .

리버풀's bid for a third successive league title is now looking stronger, as they finish November as First Division leaders with a one-point lead over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 유나이티드. 토트넘 홋스퍼 occupy fourth place, while 루턴 타운 are fifth. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, with just one win, are still bottom of the table, with 왓퍼드 (the previous season's runners-up) and 스토크 시티 completing the bottom three. 셰필드 웬즈데이 are still top of the Second Division, while 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain in the top three, with 첼시 overtaking 맨체스터 시티 to move into third. In the League Cup, 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 hold 맨체스터 유나이티드 to a 1–1 draw at the Manor Ground in a fourth round tie. United give a first team debut to 20-year-old Welsh striker Mark Hughes . 노리치 시티 beat their East Anglian rivals 입스위치 타운 1–0 at Portman Road . There is another local derby in the competition at The Hawthorns , where 애스턴 빌라 beat 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 2–1. In the only league action of the day, 레스터 시티 climb out of the bottom three with a 2–1 home win over 사우샘프턴.
